chunks: The day all secrets are examined
ai.seo_question: What does 'Yawma tubla as-sara'ir' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from the hidden realm of the heart (al-batin) to the manifest reality of the Day of Resurrection, highlighting that divine judgment is based on the purity of one's inner convictions, not merely outward actions. It serves as a profound reminder for believers to cultivate sincerity (ikhlas) and self-accountability (muhasabah) in their daily lives, knowing that Allah's knowledge encompasses all secrets.
